name: Teotihuacan
description: Teotihuacan is a vast pre-Columbian city in the Valley of Mexico, approximately 40 km northeast of Mexico City, that was one of the largest cities in the ancient world at its peak (c. 100,000–200,000 inhabitants around 400–500 CE); its builders remain unknown, and the city features extraordinary astronomical alignments, a 100-meter ritual tunnel sealed for 2,000 years, and evidence of collective governance unlike other ancient civilizations.

aliases.name: Teohuacan
aliases.meaning: proposed alternate original name meaning 'City of the Sun' (scholarly debate, 2018)

aliases.name: Puh
aliases.meaning: Place of Reeds — Maya designation for the city found in Maya texts

aliases.name: Teōtīhuacān
aliases.meaning: Birthplace of the gods — name given by the Aztecs who arrived after the city's abandonment

regions: State of Mexico (municipio de San Juan Teotihuacan)
origin: Single location in the Valley of Mexico, but cultural influence extended across Mesoamerica during the city's peak period (1–650 CE).
